scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build:runtime-packages: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-zod run build
scripts.build:vercel: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:runtime-packages && PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/auto-site run build && PORT=3001 BASE_PATH=/admin/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/admin run build && rm -rf artifacts/auto-site/dist/public/admin && mkdir -p artifacts/auto-site/dist/public/admin && cp -R artifacts/admin/dist/public/. artifacts/auto-site/dist/public/admin/
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
